## Objective

## Evidence
Provide evidence that demonstrates completion. Examples:

- code or configuration;
- commands and relevant output;
- automated tests;
- logs;
- screenshots when they add technical value;
- troubleshooting notes;
- architecture notes or ADR;
- Pull Request link.

## Notes / Constraints
Document assumptions, blockers, security considerations, or scope boundaries.
